description: (Recommended first step) Classify a Sui address as wallet, package, validator or object before choosing other tools. For wallets, package_activity scans the first 20 sent transactions for publishes/upgrades and provides next_call to continue; the result also includes balance and name context. Package results include modules and bridge labels on defined objects; bridge_carrier identifies bytecode calls into curated bridge exits. Validator results include stake information. A wallet's first_seen is the oldest transaction GraphQL returns where it sent or was affected, with received coins read across all balance-change pages. first_inflow means it gained coins without sending, including genesis with sender:null; genesis names no funding wallet. Incomplete balance changes with no observed gain leave first_inflow null. first_seen_unavailable marks a failed first read. Use find_funding_sources when the first transaction was only a token airdrop.
name: identify_address
title: Identify address
